descricao: A room with red paint. Red-painted walls occur less frequently than blue or cream ones. The walls are coated with blue, cream, and red paint that is cracked and peeling, exposing a layer of plaster or corroded steel. The ceiling supports many light fixtures, all of which are dysfunctional. Despite the lack of artificial lighting, beams of light emanate from arbitrary spots in the ceiling and walls, illuminating a majority of the rooms with a sunlight-like glow.
